in_marathi.name: Kahar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kahar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kahar is derived from the Hindi word 'kala', which means 'black'. It is also associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as having a black body and is considered the god of strength, courage, and protection.
